question: Can one who employs these great cakras obtain without doubt whatever diverse thing is desired?
premises: the practitioner obtains the desired object
there is no doubt about this result
the desired object may be various
inference: employment of these great cakras yields any desired object without doubt
uncertainties: the exact scope of vividhaṃ remains context-dependent
the subject of labhati is not explicit in this verse
plain_english: One obtains indeed, without doubt, whatever diverse thing is desired.
